title: Over a field an injective matrix has a nonzero maximal minor
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $n,p\ge0$ integers and $B$ a $p\times n$ matrix with entries in $K$ [def-weil-matrix] such that the $K$-linear map $K^n\to K^p$, $v\mapsto Bv$, is injective. Then $n\le p$, and there is a set $S=\{i_1<\dots<i_n\}\subseteq\{1,\dots,p\}$ of $n$ row indices such that the $n\times n$ submatrix $B_S=(b_{i_x j})_{1\le x,j\le n}$ of $B$ on the rows $S$ and all columns [def-weil-submatrix] has nonzero determinant [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant], $\det B_S\neq0$ (for $n=0$, $S=\emptyset$ and $\det B_S=1$).
